Join Bayesian PCA Imputations of Different Columns

Source: R/mi_pca_s3.R
cbind.si_mi.Rd

Join finalized fits made on the same rows over different columns into one fit, such as a large matrix fitted one chromosome at a time.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'si_mi'
cbind(..., deparse.level = 1)

Arguments

...

One or more si_mi objects. Finalized fits, from mipca(), mipca_fit() or mipca_finalize().

deparse.level

Not used.

Value

A finalized fit of class si_mi, over the columns of every fit. A single fit is returned as it is.

Details

The joined fit. The columns come in the order the fits are given. Draw b of the joined fit is draw b of every fit, so its completed matrix is the completed matrices of the fits at draw b, side by side.

What must match. The fits must have the same row names in the same order and the same number of kept draws, so fit and finalize each with the same chains, iter_sampling and thin. A column can be in one fit only. The rank, transform and other settings can differ.

Seeds. Give each fit its own seed, to reduce the correlation between the draws of different fits.

Refusals. A resumable fit, made with keep_state = TRUE, is refused. Finalize it with mipca_finalize() first.

See also

  • mipca() to fit each part.

  • as.matrix() and summary(), which take the joined fit as any other.

Examples

set.seed(1)
sim <- sim_mat(n = 50, p = 40, beta = TRUE)
obj <- sim$input

# Fit two blocks of columns, each with its own seed, and join them
left <- mipca(obj[, 1:20], rank = 2, transform = "logit_biwhiten", seed = 1)
right <- mipca(obj[, 21:40], rank = 2, transform = "logit_biwhiten", seed = 2)
fit <- cbind(left, right)
fit
#> si_mi fit: 50 x 40, 200 imputed cells, 400 draws
#>   next: as.matrix() with 'draw' for a completed matrix, summary() for Rhat and ESS
dim(as.matrix(fit, draw = 1))
#> [1] 50 40
